verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred two-line serif headline and adapts it well to the landscape canvas. Its flaw is that the type is scaled up so far that the side margins (~35px) and the vertical breathing room are much tighter than the original's quiet, generous whitespace, so it loses some of the 'silence' feel. B pushes the headline block into the upper-left with a ~30px left margin, leaving the right ~40% and bottom ~40% as dead space, so the layout is lopsided. Its centred-within-block alignment then looks arbitrary against the off-centre placement, which reads as a broken placement, not intent.
